invariants.rationale: partitionPath is required to reference a specific partition, and null would likely not be a valid argument.
An empty partitionPath likely does not reference a meaningful partition, so the method assumes non-empty input.
table is accessed in the method, so it must not be null at entry.
config is needed for getting the small file size threshold, so it must not be null at method entry.
partitionPath probably should not have leading or trailing whitespace, as it is used as a key or identifier.
